}}'''Lideine Rajan''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] who lived after the [[Breaking of the World]] and before the founding of the [[White Tower]]. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Lideine Rajan}}

==History==
Circa {{Ab|47}}, Lideine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ''ajah'' (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

From a letter dated {{ab|77}}, it is stated that Lideine has since been [[stilled]], along with several of her followers.{{ref||bwb 9}} It is highly likely that Lideine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of {{ab|47}}.

It appears she was a leader among the Aes Sedai who refused to follow [[Elisane Tishar]], since after her stilling, most of the resistance against Elisane came to a halt.
